classes.name: Urban land
classes.definition: Man-made, built-up areas with human artifacts.

classes.name: Agriculture land
classes.definition: Farms, planned plantation, cropland, orchards, vineyards, nurseries and horticulture.

classes.name: Rangeland
classes.definition: Any non-forest, non-farm green land: grass and shrubs.

classes.name: Forest land
classes.definition: Land with tree-crown cover, including clear-cuts.

classes.name: Barren land
classes.definition: Mountain, rock, sand, river bars and other land without vegetation.
